field_modules.model: Common fixed-sigma CIC mass deposition plus separable normalized Gaussian smoothing
field_modules.kernel_support: Each axis uses integer offsets through ceil(cutoff*filter_sigma/spacing), inclusive
field_modules.mass_rule: q=(2*pi)^1.5*P*sigma^3; deposit q/spacing^3; normalize each 1D Gaussian kernel to sum 1
field_modules.field_units: Same pressure units as source peak P
field_modules.approximation: CIC compensation matches the random-phase mean second moment only, not exact Gaussians
field_modules.boundary: Deposit and smooth on halo, then crop ROI; Gaussian pressure outside ROI is excluded
field_modules.sigma_policy: Common fixed sigma per instance; distinct fixed-width bins require separate fields summed together
